verdict.rationale: Unleash documents impact-metric safeguards that gate milestone progression on error-rate thresholds and automatically pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold, including latency regressions. Metrics can come from its own impact metrics or be queried from Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, and this sits within automated release templates. Missing for 10: an explicit automatic rollback that reverts rollout percentage (docs describe pausing or disabling the environment instead), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the safeguards work in practice.
